title: Defending an attack
line: Trade attackers and counterattack in the center.

steps.text: White has castled on the other wing and can throw pawns at your king. Strike back in the center before the attack arrives.
Strike in the center instead: push the pawn in front of your queen one square further, offering it.
steps.after: White took the pawn, and the center is opening.

steps.text: Take back the knight with the pawn.
steps.after: White wants to trade off your strongest defender, the bishop.

steps.text: Trade the bishops. Each trade takes an attacker off the board.
steps.after: White's attacking bishop is gone, and the center is open for your pieces too.

summary: Against an attack on your king, strike back in the center and trade off the attacking pieces.
